$comment: High and critical npm advisories the CI gate is allowed to pass, with the reason.
An entry is only legitimate while there is genuinely nothing to upgrade to.
scripts/audit-gate.mjs fails if an entry here no longer matches a live advisory,
so an exception cannot outlive the problem it was written for, and fails again
once `review` passes so it cannot quietly become permanent.

why: Nothing to upgrade to that the SDK can use. The fix is zod 4.6.6, and
zod ^3. zod 4 changes the API the SDK calls, so an npm override could break
the plugin's messaging with RemNote and would need testing on a real install
zod IS in the published plugin bundle, unlike the dev server advisories. The
advisory is memory exhaustion while validating an oversized constrained
collection. In this plugin zod validates only the SDK's messages to and from
the RemNote app, never anything a third party supplies, and the theme zip has
Revisit by the review date: either a new SDK on zod 4, or try a zod override
and verify settings, registerCSS and the debug popup on an uploaded build.
